name: Optical Fiber
summary:
Optical Fiber Installation in an Existing Building

You are an optical fiber technician. Your task is to connect the optical fiber so that the customer can access very high-speed broadband. The scenario takes place in an old apartment building that is currently being connected to the fiber network.

Connecting a Subscriber in Two Activities : 

- Installation, connection and fiber splicing in the building riser
- Optical testing of the connection
